review_description: Eric from Green and Save Solar was fantastic from first conversation to site inspection to install with his team to follow up after install.The initial quote was via email then followed up with an onsite inspection as we live in a terrace in a heritage zone.Installation was fast and efficient carried out by Eric and his professional team. They started at 8am and finished at 1pm installing 19 panels (6 with optimisers) plus an 8kw inverter. No mess was left behind, they went out of their way with moving our plants and looking after our house.Eric went over the Solis Cloud app we installed so we can see what we are producing, drawing from the grid and most importantly putting back into the grid, Just Fabulous.My wife and I cannot recommend Eric and his team from Green and Save Solar highly enough, Honest and very Reliable!Cheers,Tim Buter

This family owned business has been a delight to work with. They were professional and gave the best advice to what I really wanted and needed for a growing family.The quoting process was alright, managed to get the really good price for value based on the parts I get.Installation was quick and efficient, it took less than a day and it has been producing electricity.Overall, pretty happy with the system!

Great installation overall, workmanship is top notch. Installers are very friendly and professional. Marketing guys could do better with faster communication and more presentable quotation but having said that if you call them and no answer they will call you back as soon as they can.  They claim they were on the solar market for over 10 years hopefully they will still be here in another 10 for warranty purposes.

Eric was providing a smooth process from start to finish, from quoting process to installation and after-support phase. Installation was good, his team arrived on time and did a wonderful installation, communicated what they do regularly, when there's something happening (1 of the tile broke and they honestly mentioned that). There's a slight hiccup since due to roof space, some of the panels weren't able to be installed in the north side as per the quotation hence required to be moved to south side of the roof, which will obviously perform less effective. However Eric kindly offered a good discount to the initial quote which was acceptable solution.Green & Save also helped organising the grid connection (I had to do the initial sign up with the new provider myself first) and their project manager was helpful and very responsive to my emails and/or questions.
This is a responsible and honest company, they provided me great product and service. Highly recommended.
